points.description: Names the main building blocks of a CNN: convolutional layer(s) (kernels/filters sliding over the input image) together with pooling layer(s) (max or average), in any wording.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of convolution or pooling is given, or the description is vague.

points.description: States that after the convolution/pooling stages there are fully connected layer(s) leading to an output (softmax) layer, with an activation such as ReLU in the structure.
points.partial_credit: Half if only fully connected/output layer or only activation is mentioned.

rubric.notes: Full marks for listing the main layers in a CNN in any wording: convolution and pooling, then fully connected and output layers, with activation mentioned. Give part marks if the answer names some layers but leaves out a main group. Give no marks if the answer is off-topic or describes a different network. Missing details such as the exact pooling type or softmax cost nothing.
